C0956.title: Chengdu Police Report on Staged 'Blind Date Video': Six Detained for Fabricating Fake Identities
C0956.summary: On March 13, 2025, police in Wuhou District, Chengdu, reported that a 'Love Technology' company from another province fabricated facts, recruited individuals, and created false identity information such as 'working at a provincial-level agency with an annual income of 350,000-400,000' to plan blind date videos for online traffic and profit.
